title: Australian Cream Biscuit Lasagna
description: A unique twist on traditional lasagna, this Australian-inspired dessert features layers of cream biscuits, Oreo cookies, and a rich, salty cream sauce.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, crush the cream biscuits and Oreo cookies.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the sweetened cream, salt, and vanilla extract.
Beat in the eggs and milk until well combined.
Add the crushed biscuits and Oreo cookies to the cream mixture and stir until just combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
